# Setup

See [Intro to LangGraph](https://academy.langchain.com/courses/take/intro-to-langgraph/texts/58238105-getting-set-up)

## Environment Variables

> [!NOTE] About ENV File
>
> - Must add `.env` file in repo directory
> - Must copy `.env` file to each module sub-directories

## How to Setup Environment

```{bash}
# Clone repo
git clone git@github.com:jah377/langchain-academy.git
cd langchain-academy

# Create environment from requirements.txt
uv init
uv add -r requirements.txt

# Create jupyter kernel
uv add ipykernel
uv run python -m ipykernel install --user --name langchain-academy
```

## Ollama Setup

See [Setting up Ollama](https://github.com/jah377/zettelkasten/blob/main/notes/langchain/20260619__LangChain-Setting-Up-Ollama.qmd)

```{bash}
uv add langchain_ollama
```

## LangSmith Studio Setup

Must install `langgraph` in virtual environment to use `LangSmith Studio` for
viewing and testing agent.

```{bash}
uv add "langgraph-cli[inmem]"
```

To run `langgraph`, must call `uv run langgraph dev` from inside one of the
**module-{{i}}** subdirectories in the repo. Should see the following:

> - 🚀 API: http://127.0.0.1:2024
> - 🎨 Studio UI: https://smith.langchain.com/studio/?baseUrl=http://127.0.0.1:2024
> - 📚 API Docs: http://127.0.0.1:2024/docs

## Tavily Setup

While `tavily` web-search tool worked using the `lca-lc-foundations` virtual
environment, it did not work using the `langchain-academy` environment.

```{bash}
# Packages in `lca-lc-foundation` but missing from `langchain-academy`
# Didn't resolve the issue
uv add python-dotenv tavily-python tavily

# Finally was able to get it to work
uv add pip-system-certs
```

To test:

```{python}
from dotenv import load_dotenv

load_dotenv()

from langchain_tavily import TavilySearch  # updated at 1.0

tavily_search = TavilySearch(max_results=3)

data = tavily_search.invoke({"query": "What is LangGraph?"})
search_docs = data.get("results", data)


from pprint import pprint

pprint(search_docs)
```
